eyebrow: Who can do what, right now
code:
SELECT
    pr.name AS principal_name,
    pe.permission_name,
    pe.state_desc
FROM sys.database_permissions pe
JOIN sys.database_principals pr
    ON pe.grantee_principal_id = pr.principal_id
WHERE pe.major_id = OBJECT_ID('dbo.Employee');
caption: state_desc shows GRANT, DENY, or GRANT_WITH_GRANT_OPTION.
The audit defines WHERE events go; the specification defines WHAT gets captured.
